en.usage:
usage: tagents-core <command>

  session open --cwd P [--label N] [--model M] [--effort E] [--resume ID]
               [--system-prompt-file F] [--mcp-config F]
               [--config-dir D | --no-config-dir] [--skip-permissions]
  session prompt <ref-json-or-id> <text> [--timeout MS] [--warn-before MS] [--events]
  session last <ref-json-or-id>
  session list [--label N] [--state S]...
  session abort <ref-json-or-id>
  sessions recent [N] | search <words…> | show <id-prefix>
  plugin list [--json]
  plugin add <package-or-path> [--name N]
  plugin remove <name>
  plugin new <name> [--dir D]
  doctor
  mcp --contract F   (Rust binary only)
  notify run   (the notification service: the Rust binary serves it and hands over to node when it cannot start)
  <plugin> <command> [args]   a configured plugin’s own verb (plugin list names them)

reserved: session · sessions · plugin · doctor · help — a core verb always wins
exit: 0 ok · 1 error · 2 usage · 3 refused · 4 timeout
en.noPrompt: nothing to say: the prompt text is empty
en.abortPaneAgent: {{ref}} runs in a tmux pane and is not stopped from here: interrupt or close it in its pane
en.pluginUnresolved: no package at {{spec}}: not a directory here, and not installed
en.pluginNoEntry: the manifest points at {{file}}, which does not exist
en.pluginScaffolded: wrote {{dir}} — install it with: tagents plugin add {{dir}}
en.summarySessionOpen: prepares a headless Claude session for a directory and prints its SessionRef as JSON; no process starts until a prompt is sent to it
en.summarySessionPrompt: runs one Claude turn: sends the prompt to a session, waits for the answer and prints the TurnOutcome as JSON; with --events, NDJSON events with the outcome last
en.summarySessionLast: prints the last assistant text of a session and when it came, as JSON, or null
en.summarySessionList: prints the known sessions as a JSON array of SessionRef, filtered by label and state
en.summarySessionAbort: stops the process of a session that has no pane and prints whether it did, with the id and pid, as JSON; a session in a tmux pane is refused with exit 3
en.summarySessionsRecent: prints the most recent transcripts as text
en.summarySessionsSearch: prints the transcripts that match the words, as text
en.summarySessionsShow: prints the full text of one transcript, picked by id prefix
en.summaryPluginList: lists the configured plugins and what each offers, as lines or with --json one JSON document
en.summaryPluginAdd: validates a package manifest and writes the plugin into the config
en.summaryPluginRemove: takes one plugin entry back out of the config
en.summaryPluginNew: scaffolds a package that is already a plugin
en.summaryDoctor: prints the node version, the state directory, the config file and whether claude is on PATH
en.summaryMcp: serves the tools of a contract file to an MCP client over stdin and stdout until the client closes them
en.summaryNotifyRun: runs the notification service in this process until a signal stops it: it follows the event stream of the agents and posts a notice for each turn that ends, each question and each permission prompt

ru.usage:
использование: tagents-core <команда>

  session open --cwd P [--label N] [--model M] [--effort E] [--resume ID]
               [--system-prompt-file F] [--mcp-config F]
               [--config-dir D | --no-config-dir] [--skip-permissions]
  session prompt <ref-json-or-id> <текст> [--timeout MS] [--warn-before MS] [--events]
  session last <ref-json-or-id>
  session list [--label N] [--state S]...
  session abort <ref-json-or-id>
  sessions recent [N] | search <слова…> | show <префикс-id>
  plugin list [--json]
  plugin add <пакет-или-путь> [--name N]
  plugin remove <имя>
  plugin new <имя> [--dir D]
  doctor
  mcp --contract F   (только бинарник на Rust)
  notify run   (сервис уведомлений: его обслуживает бинарник на Rust, а если он не может стартовать, управление передаётся node)
  <плагин> <команда> [аргументы]   команда настроенного плагина (см. plugin list)

зарезервировано: session · sessions · plugin · doctor · help — команда ядра важнее
коды выхода: 0 ок · 1 ошибка · 2 использование · 3 отказ · 4 таймаут
ru.abortPaneAgent: {{ref}} работает в панели tmux, и отсюда её не остановить: прервите или закройте её в самой панели
ru.pluginNone: в {{file}} не перечислено ни одного плагина
ru.pluginUnresolved: пакет {{spec}} не найден: ни каталог здесь, ни установленный пакет
